description: This file implements the SplitSequenceOperator functionality, which traverses an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to identify and split sequence operator expressions (comma operators) to ensure correct evaluation order and side effect handling in shader code transformations.

classes.name: SplitSequenceOperatorTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to detect sequence operators that need to be split for correct evaluation order.

methods.name: SplitSequenceOperator
methods.description: Main function that applies the splitting transformation to the AST, iteratively traversing and modifying the tree.
